issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for Lecture.addGuestStudents: the problem statement (text and UML) requires a two-parameter method addGuestStudents(int, String) — an int for the number of new guest students and a String reason — but the solution implementation provides addGuestStudents(int) with only a single int parameter. This mismatch between the specified API and the reference implementation will confuse students about the required signature and can cause compilation/test failures if tests expect the two-parameter form.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the reference implementation with the problem statement/UML by changing the method signature in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java to: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, String reason). Update the implementation to accept the reason (e.g., store it, log it, or otherwise handle/ignore it explicitly). Alternatively, if the reason parameter is intentionally unnecessary, update the problem statement and UML to specify addGuestStudents(int) so the specification and solution match. Prefer updating the solution to accept the two parameters to preserve the stated learning goals.
